exposure: scheduled cesarean sections (CS) between 38 and 39 gestational weeks
finding: Elective cesarean section at 38-39 weeks' gestation was associated with a higher rate of transient tachypnea of the newborn and NICU admission compared to elective cesarean section performed after 39 completed gestational weeks.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section at 38-39 weeks gestation is associated with a higher rate of transient tachypnea of the newborn and NICU admission compared to elective cesarean section performed after 39 completed gestational weeks.
